sessions.phase_label: Initial question, level, and generator planning
Grade content, visual representation, and prompt refinement

requirements.title: Reviewable Questions for Each Level
requirements.definition: Provide a reviewable set of three example questions for every level before creating the corresponding random generators.
requirements.boundary_note: The three-question count and question-first review sequence are attributes of one per-level question-set deliverable rather than separate Requirements; generator implementation remains independent.

requirements.title: Grade-Appropriate Curriculum Alignment
requirements.definition: Ensure topics, exercises, and levels are appropriate for the applicable grade and aligned with the intended U.S. curriculum standards.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the cross-cutting grade-alignment acceptance constraint; exact topic inclusion for a particular grade is an attribute or clarification of that constraint, not a generic testing Requirement.

requirements.title: Gradual Level Progression
requirements.definition: Structure related levels so that their content ranges or difficulty support gradual progression and curriculum blocks.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers the progression relationship among levels; the individual ranges used by a specific sorting activity remain attributes of that activity.

requirements.title: Sorting Activity Exercise Content
requirements.definition: Define the mathematical content used by the sorting activity, including appropriate even-and-odd number ranges and problems involving addition, subtraction, and multiplication.
requirements.boundary_note: The proposed numeric bands and supported operations are parameters of one sorting-activity mechanism rather than separate Requirements; the tentative wording around the numeric bands should be handled conservatively during Event extraction.

requirements.title: Question Assignment Across Applicable Levels
requirements.definition: Represent a question in every level to which it applies by duplicating the existing question entry for each applicable level.
requirements.boundary_note: This concerns the independently specified data organization for multi-level questions, not the mathematical content or number of questions in a level.

requirements.title: Distinct Visual Object Representation per Level
requirements.definition: Assign a different visual object to each level and explicitly identify its object type using the supported representation categories.
requirements.boundary_note: Object uniqueness, the object-type field, and the listed grid, numbered-box, and base-10-block categories are tightly coupled attributes of one visual-representation mechanism.

requirements.title: Level Objectives
requirements.definition: Provide an objective for each level that states its intended learning outcome.
requirements.boundary_note: Learning objectives are a distinct content artifact that can be revised independently of question counts, visual objects, and gameplay descriptions.

requirements.title: Gameplay Activity Descriptions
requirements.definition: Describe how each activity is presented and how the player interacts with it so the content can be integrated into the game.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers gameplay setup and player-interaction descriptions; level learning objectives and object-type selection are separately editable artifacts.

requirements.title: Space Station Content Across All Intended Grades
requirements.definition: Provide the complete Space Station mini-game content across every intended grade level rather than limiting delivery to Grade 5.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the independent grade-coverage obligation; individual grade completion reports are partial execution evidence and should not be treated as verification of all-grade coverage.

requirements.title: Reusable AI Content-Generation Prompt
requirements.definition: Create an effective reusable ChatGPT prompt that automates content generation across grades and explicitly constrains both desired and prohibited output.
requirements.boundary_note: The prompt is an independently requested executable tooling artifact; its positive and negative instructions are attributes of that artifact, while the C# runtime generator is separate.

requirements.title: Constraint-Compliant C# Random Generator
requirements.definition: Implement and test a C# pseudo-random generator that produces exercises satisfying the defined mathematical constraints.
requirements.boundary_note: The generator algorithm, exercise constraints, and C# technology choice are attributes of one executable generator artifact; environment setup failures are execution evidence rather than a separate setup or debugging Requirement.

unresolved_candidates.description: The freelancer asked about using Python for code checking, but no supplied client message authorizes replacing or supplementing the required C# implementation with Python.

The exact Grade 5 inclusion or exclusion of geometry, graphs, measurements, division, and fractions is not conclusively resolved; the client expresses uncertainty rather than a definitive curriculum decision.

Conveyor-belt presentation and player interaction are reported by the freelancer as completed, but the supplied history does not contain a target-explicit client decision establishing their exact required values.
The required number of levels per topic remains unresolved because the proposed range of 10 to 14 levels receives no supplied client answer.
